title: Son of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: Cang Yutian sneered coldly: 'Is this the so-called bond between you? Nothing more than another preordained script.'

text.content: Before the mountain collapse's echoes could fade, Chen Ji's divine sense pierced through the flying rocks like a blade, searching for that familiar aura. Su Qingyao—that name swept across his heart, bringing not fear, but an agonizing sting that reached the marrow. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently in his Mental Sea, as if sensing a forbidden secret that should never be touched.

Yet in the next instant, a voice so gentle yet cruel rang in his ear, like spring wind in March brushing across ice frozen for a millennium. 'Ji Lang, you've finally arrived.' Chen Ji's body froze instantly. This form of address... why would Cang Yutian speak words that belonged only to memories buried by the erosion of time?

dialogue.content: 'Thirty thousand years, and you're still so impatient.' That voice carried a smile, yet it made cold sweat break out on Chen Ji's back. 'You've already seen the answer, yet you still need to confirm it with your own eyes. Ji Lang, this habit of yours existed thirty thousand years ago.'

text.content: Chen Ji spun around, only to find Cang Yutian had somehow risen into mid-air, surrounded by faint golden threads of destiny like an supreme being controlling the cosmic chess game. Yet her features at this moment overlapped with a vague outline from memory—those eyes, that hint of a smile that seemed neither reproaching nor amused, which were precisely the phantom he dared not touch most in his midnight dreams.

dialogue.content: 'Who exactly are you?' Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, not sounding like his own. 'Don't use that face to say such words.'

text.content: Cang Yutian laughed lightly, that smile carrying thirty thousand years of vicissitudes and vigil. She walked slowly toward Chen Ji, each step pressing on the strings of destiny, playing a heartbreaking melody. 'Who am I?' she asked back. 'I am the one you buried with your own hands, and also the soul that has watched over you for thirty thousand years.'

dialogue.content: 'When you chose to merge with the Tianji Record to seal the Heavenly Dao's will, I, as the price, was stripped by the Heavenly Dao of all memories of you.' Cang Yutian's voice began to tremble, thirty thousand years of suppressed emotions bursting their dam at this moment. 'Do you know how I've spent these thirty thousand years?'

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Memories surged like a tide—the person who smiled under the peach blossom tree and said 'Ji Lang, I want you through eternity,' the one who remained by his side when his cultivation was completely destroyed, the one who cried herself hoarse watching him sacrifice his body to embody the Dao. Wan'er... that was Wan'er's name.

'The Heavenly Dao took my memories, but it couldn't take my obsession.' Cang Yutian, no, Wan'er's remnant soul, finally awakened completely at this moment. 'For thirty thousand years, I've walked through all worlds as the Fate Writer, only to find your traces and wait for this reunion.'

choice.prompt: Facing the awakening of his lover from ten thousand years ago, how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: Acknowledge this bond spanning ten thousand years, but does the current situation allow him to indulge in romance?
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Fate Writer's Wholehearted Assistance
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao May Seize the Opportunity to Counterattack
choices.process_label: 他缓缓伸出手，指尖触上那张熟悉的面容

text.content: Chen Ji's trembling hand raised, fingertips touching that face spanning ten thousand years. The warmth was real, the saltiness of tears was also real. 'Wan'er...' He spoke this name, his voice carrying thirty thousand years of unspeakable sobs. Cang Yutian's eyes instantly reddened, that heart frozen for thirty thousand years finally melting completely at this moment.

choices.description: Suppress the surging emotions in his heart, question whether this is another orchestrated chess game?
choices.visible_cost: May Hurt the Person Before Him
choices.visible_reward: See the Full Picture of the Situation
choices.process_label: 他后退一步，眼神重新恢复冷漠与审视

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, and those profound eyes were once again filled with cold indifference. 'Thirty thousand years of planning, all for this reunion?' His voice was terrifyingly calm. 'Wan'er, or should I call you Cang Yutian? Chess piece of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, Fate Writer—are you here to find me, or to execute another mission?'

Cang Yutian watched Chen Ji's retreating motion, a flash of pain crossing her eyes, but it was quickly replaced by acceptance. 'You've changed, Ji Lang.' she said softly. 'The you from ten thousand years ago would have embraced me without hesitation.'

dialogue.content: "Ten thousand years ago, I also didn't need to navigate step by step through the chaos of the three major sects' oppression and the demonic path invasion." Chen Ji's voice carried bitterness. "Wan'er, you say I've changed. But have you ever thought that these thirty thousand years of waiting, I too have been experiencing?"

text.content: As the words fell, Chen Ji suddenly felt the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea tremble violently again. This time, it wasn't a warning, but resonance. A blurry image emerged on the fragment—it was the moment of his final battle ten thousand years ago, when he perished together with the Heavenly Dao Will. And at the edge of the image, a blurry figure was kneeling in the ruins, crying her heart out.

Chen Ji's heart suddenly tightened. He saw it—the moment Wan'er desperately tried to hold onto him, but he sealed her memories with his own hands. "I'm sorry." These three words spilled from his lips, carrying ten thousand years of unspoken apologies. "I thought sealing your memories was the best way to protect you."

dialogue.content: "So you chose to make me forget you, to bear everything alone?" Cang Yutian's voice trembled with pain. "Chen Ji, do you know how much I hated you when I recovered my memories and found that I had forgotten the person I loved most in this life?" Tears slid from the corners of her eyes, turning into golden specks of light as they fell into the Void.

choice.prompt: Facing Wan'er's cross-millennium questioning and hatred, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Admit that the decision at the time hurt her and ask for her forgiveness
choices.risk_hint: May be seen as weak by the other party
choices.process_label: 他单膝跪地，以行动表达万年的歉意

text.content: Chen Ji slowly knelt on one knee. This posture made Cang Yutian freeze instantly. "What are you doing?" Her voice panicked. "Ten thousand years ago you never bowed your head to anyone, so why now..." Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze directly meeting her eyes: "This kneel is on behalf of that selfish me from ten thousand years ago, to apologize to you."

choices.description: Explain the circumstances at the time—if Wan'er remembered everything, she would only suffer more
choices.visible_reward: Let the other party understand one's own hardships
choices.process_label: 他站起身来，目光坚定地回望

text.content: Chen Ji slowly stood up, his gaze carrying the weight of ten thousand years. "Wan'er, do you think I wanted to forget you?" His voice was low. "But if I let you remember, you would be targeted by the Eyes of Heavenly Dao. Erasing your memories was the only way I could protect you—even if it made you hate me."

Cang Yutian watched him quietly, her tears gradually stopping, replaced by a complex emotion. Thirty thousand years of hatred, thirty thousand years of longing, thirty thousand years of waiting—all of it turned into a long sigh at this moment. "Ji Lang, do you know why I've been scheming for thirty thousand years as a Fate Writer?"

dialogue.content: "Not for revenge, not to surpass Heavenly Dao." She walked closer to Chen Ji, reaching out to gently touch his face. "But to bring you back to life." Her fingertips trembled slightly. "When you perished together with Heavenly Dao, I collected your soul fragments and hid them in every page of the Tianji Record's fragments. As long as the Tianji Record becomes complete, you can truly be reborn."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils suddenly constricted. The trembling of the Tianji Record Fragment, the consumption each time he foresaw the future, the backlash his body endured—all along, it was Wan'er secretly maintaining the balance, using her own threads of fate to repair his soul that was constantly on the verge of collapse. "So during these thirty thousand years..." his voice choked, "you've been burning your Heavenly Fate Value to repair me?"

Cang Yutian didn't answer, only giving him a gentle smile. That smile carried thirty thousand years of exhaustion and no regrets, yet was still breathtakingly beautiful. "Now that you've been reborn and the Tianji Record is nearly complete." Her voice suddenly turned somber. "But this also means that the Heavenly Fate Value I've burned for you is almost exhausted."

Chen Ji's heart suddenly sank. He finally understood—Wan'er's rebirth came with a price, and that price was her own existence. "No..." He instinctively reached out his hand, wanting to grasp something, but only touched emptiness. Cang Yutian's figure began to become transparent, like thin silk being pierced by sunlight.

"Don't be afraid, Ji Lang." Cang Yutian's voice remained gentle. "My soul has long merged with the Tianji Record. As long as you continue forward with the Tianji Record, I will always be with you." She injected the last thread of fate into Chen Ji's Mental Sea. "Go, complete your unfinished mission. This time, it's my turn to guard you."

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian looked at him one last time, that gaze containing ten thousand years of deep love and reluctance to part. "Remember, no matter how far you go or how deep you scheme, don't forget your original self." Her voice gradually drifted away. "Because that is the Chen Ji I fell in love with—the fool who would dare to defy Heaven for the one he loved."

text.content: Chen Ji poured out all the Heavenly Fate Value from his Mental Sea without hesitation, golden light cascading like the Milky Way, wrapping layer upon layer around Cang Yutian's fading figure. "I won't let you leave again!" His voice carried determination. "Ten thousand years ago I couldn't keep you. This lifetime, even if I must defy heaven and change fate, I will be with you!"

choices.description: Respect her choice, transform her will into the power to continue forward
choices.visible_cost: Endure the pain of eternal farewell
choices.visible_reward: Receive Wan'er's complete blessing and power inheritance
choices.risk_hint: May leave eternal scars on the heart
choices.process_label: 他握住她最后的温暖，让她安心离去

text.content: Chen Ji stopped struggling, gently grasping Cang Yutian's dissipating hand. "I understand." His voice was low yet calm. "Your thirty-thousand-year scheme wasn't for reunion, but to let me continue forward without worry." A flash of relief flickered in Cang Yutian's eyes—he was still that meticulous, flawless Chen Ji.

The moment Cang Yutian's figure completely dissipated, an ancient and authoritative voice suddenly thundered through the void. Chen Ji looked up sharply to see a bottomless black rift tearing across the horizon, the will of the Eyes of Heavenly Way spreading from within, carrying an aura that sought to annihilate all.

dialogue.content: "Is this the bond you speak of?" The voice sneered, brimming with mockery and disdain. "Merely another rehearsed script." Chen Ji's fists clenched tight, his knuckles whitening. The Eyes of Heavenly Way continued: "Do you think she burned thirty thousand years of Heavenly Fate Value out of love? It was merely to accomplish this final step—making you the perfect vessel."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, but he quickly suppressed the turmoil in his heart. Ten thousand years of scheming, the废物 facade, the meticulous strategist—he had long grown accustomed to finding flaws between lies and truth. The more the Eyes of Heavenly Way tried to shake him, the more it proved his existence threatened it. "A script?" He sneered. "If it truly were a script, why would you appear in person?"

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, the threads of fate left by Wan'er gently circulating within his Mental Sea. The fragments of the Tianji Record ceased their trembling, replaced by an unprecedented tranquility. He could sense Wan'er's presence—not dissipated, but transformed into another form of existence, eternally inscribed within the Tianji Record. "You're right, Eyes of Heavenly Way." His eyes opened, icy light flickering within. "This is indeed a script. However—the Chess Player has never been you."

The aura of the Eyes of Heavenly Way suddenly froze. It sensed the threat, sensed that man who had once mutually destroyed with it was awakening. The black vortex began to spin madly, countless Heavenly Laws intertwining within, attempting to devour Chen Ji. Yet Chen Ji merely raised his hand, the fragments of the Tianji Record materializing in his palm, Wan'er's final thread of power gently flowing within.

"Thirty thousand years ago, I embodied the Dao to protect those I loved." Chen Ji's voice was calm yet resolute. "Thirty thousand years later, I will fight you again for the same purpose." He absorbed the Tianji Record fragments into his Mental Sea. In that moment, what he felt was no longer solitude—Wan'er's presence was with him, and ten thousand years of waiting and scheming would bloom with light at this very instant.

In the distance, within the mountain ruins devastated by Cang Yutian's collapse, a hazy figure slowly rose. It was Su Qingyao—she had narrowly survived the collapse, yet witnessed everything she shouldn't have. Her gaze pierced through the dust, fixed intently on Chen Ji's direction, her eyes reflecting complex emotions. The Chess Game of Fate had been thoroughly disrupted, and she stood right at the center of the board.

Chen Ji sensed that gaze yet didn't turn around. He knew from this moment, everything would change. Wan'er's departure, the Eyes of Heavenly Way's manifestation, Su Qingyao's witness—all events were pushing him toward a point of no return. Yet he felt no fear, for the gentle presence within the Tianji Record whispered to him: however arduous the path ahead, he was no longer fighting alone.

The vortex of the Eyes of Heavenly Way gradually receded, yet those transcendent eyes remained fixed on Chen Ji, as if observing a being about to break free from its cocoon. "Interesting." It left with these final words. "Then let me see how far this so-called Son of Destiny can go." As the voice faded, the black hole sealed completely, leaving only devastated mountains and a figure embarking anew on his journey.
